planets.name: WASP-60 b
planets.description: Transiting planet of Morava with a 4.31-day year, found in 2012.

text.card: WASP-60 b was found in 2012 by SuperWASP as it crossed its star.
text.introduction: It is the only planet known around Morava. Its orbit and size follow Stassun et al. 2017's fit, the archive's default.
text.locator: NASA Exoplanet Archive ps table, default parameter set (pl_refname STASSUN_ET_AL__2017): disc_year 2012, disc_facility SuperWASP, sy_pnum 1; pl_orbper 4.3050061, pl_radj 0.88, pl_bmassj 0.55
